claims.quote: The GAP Activity Towards Rags 1 (GATOR1) complex, which includes DEPDC5, NPRL2, and NPRL3, plays a key role in epilepsy.
We report two rare mutations in the NPRL3 gene in two unrelated Chinese families with focal epilepsy in this study.
Bioinformatics analysis predicted that the mutation (c.954C>A) was in the highly conserved amino acid residues of NPRL3, which affected the α-helix of NPRL3 protein, leading to a truncated protein.
The splice variant (c.1545-1G>C) resulted in the loss of the last exon of the NPRL3 gene.
Surprisingly, the mothers of the two probands each carried the variants, but neither had an attack.
